metadata.title: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 | Uniglo Diamonds
metadata.description: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA Munich 2027, 19–22 February at Messe München. Explore natural diamonds and book a trade meeting in Munich.

announcement: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 · 19–22 February · Trade Fair Center Messe München · Meet Uniglo Diamonds

hero.title: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds
hero.para1: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 takes place from 19 to 22 February at the Trade Fair Center Messe München in Germany. The international trade exhibition brings together jewellery retailers, manufacturers, designers, diamond buyers, gemstone specialists, watch professionals and industry service providers.
hero.para2: Uniglo Diamonds is preparing to meet European and international jewellery professionals in Munich with a selected natural-diamond presentation. Buyers can discuss individually graded centre stones, fancy-shaped diamonds, matched pairs, calibrated selections and repeat-supply requirements.
hero.para3: Uniglo Diamonds' hall and stand number have not yet been confirmed for the 2027 exhibition. The location will be added to this page as soon as it is officially available.

datesVenue.title: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 Dates & Venue
datesVenue.para1: The exhibition opens on Friday, 19 February and continues until Monday, 22 February 2027. It will be held at the Trade Fair Center Messe München, one of Germany's principal international exhibition venues.
datesVenue.para2: Visitor hours are scheduled for 09:30–18:30 from Friday through Sunday and 09:30–17:00 on Monday. Because event information can be updated, visitors should confirm the latest timetable, admission conditions and hall plan before finalising travel arrangements.

whatIs.title: What Is INHORGENTA Munich?
whatIs.para1: INHORGENTA is an international business platform for jewellery, watches and gemstones. Its exhibition areas cover fine jewellery, timepieces, gemstones, wedding and design collections, lifestyle jewellery, technology, packaging and other professional services.
whatIs.para2: The organiser currently reports approximately 1,200 brands from 38 countries, around 25,000 trade visitors from approximately 100 countries and six halls covering more than 64,000 square metres.
whatIs.para3: For jewellery businesses, this range creates an opportunity to compare products, examine developing trends, meet suppliers and make sourcing decisions within one professional environment. Supporting programmes such as TRENDFACTORY MUNICH and the INHORGENTA AWARD also place commercial buying decisions within the wider context of design, craftsmanship, retail and innovation.

exhibitors.title: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 Exhibitors & Sourcing Opportunities
exhibitors.para1: Exhibitors represent different parts of the jewellery, gemstone and watch value chain. Visitors can explore finished jewellery, loose gemstones, natural diamonds, bridal collections, contemporary design, tools, packaging and retail technology.
exhibitors.para2: Diamond buyers should approach the exhibition with a defined commercial objective. A retailer may be reviewing gaps in its bridal inventory, while a manufacturer may need repeatable measurements for an upcoming collection. Bespoke jewellers may be searching for an individual centre stone, and wholesalers may want to assess consistent supply across several specifications.
exhibitors.para3: Preparing requirements in advance makes it easier to compare suitable suppliers without allowing the scale of the exhibition to dilute the purpose of the visit.
prepItems: Required diamond shapes and carat ranges

meet.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA Munich
meet.para1: Uniglo Diamonds plans to present natural diamonds for retail, wholesale, manufacturing and bespoke-jewellery requirements. The final exhibition selection will depend on availability closer to the event.
meet.para2: Instead of treating every enquiry as a request for the same inventory, the Uniglo team begins with the intended jewellery application, customer profile and commercial objective. This helps narrow the discussion to diamonds that are more relevant to the buyer.
meet.meetingLabel: Visitors can arrange a meeting to discuss:
meet.para3: Buyers with detailed requirements should book in advance and provide their preferred specifications. This allows the team to prepare a more focused selection where availability permits.
meet.imageAlt: Natural-diamond buyer meeting Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA

european.title: Natural Diamonds for European Jewellery Businesses
european.para1: European jewellery businesses serve varied markets, from independent bridal retailers and bespoke goldsmiths to international manufacturers and wholesalers. Their diamond requirements can differ considerably in size, documentation, price position and repeatability.
european.para2: Retailers may need centre stones that complement existing engagement-ring mountings or fill clear gaps in their current assortment. Bespoke jewellers may prioritise an individual diamond's outline and face-up appearance, while manufacturers often require tighter control over measurements and consistency.
european.para3: Two diamonds with the same shape and carat weight can have noticeably different measurements and visual characteristics. Reviewing these factors together helps buyers make decisions based on the finished jewellery rather than a grading description alone.
european.considerLabel: Uniglo Diamonds can help buyers assess natural diamonds according to the combination of characteristics that matters to the finished piece:

bridal.title: Natural Diamonds for Bridal Jewellery
bridal.para1: Bridal jewellery remains an important sourcing category for many European retailers and manufacturers. Depending on the business, requirements may include documented solitaire stones, fancy-shaped centre diamonds, coordinated side stones or calibrated diamonds for repeatable ring designs.
bridal.para2: Before attending, retailers should identify which shapes, sizes and commercial price positions are missing from their bridal assortment. Manufacturers should also provide mounting dimensions when diamonds need to fit an existing design.
bridal.discussLabel: Buyers can discuss natural diamonds for:

whatCanSource.title: What Buyers Should Source at INHORGENTA
whatCanSource.para1: A productive sourcing appointment should concentrate on a defined inventory or manufacturing need. Attempting to review every available shape and grade can make comparisons less useful.

items.title: Individually Graded Centre Stones
items.body: Retailers and bespoke jewellers can discuss documented natural diamonds for engagement rings, anniversary jewellery and individual customer commissions. Relevant requirements may include a preferred laboratory, measurements, budget range and setting style.

items.title: Fancy-Shaped Natural Diamonds
items.body: Oval, Pear, Emerald, Cushion, Radiant, Marquise, Princess, Asscher and Heart-shaped diamonds can support different design and retail objectives. Outline, symmetry and length-to-width ratio should be assessed alongside conventional grading information.

items.title: Diamonds for Existing Mountings
items.body: When a diamond must fit an existing ring or jewellery component, accurate minimum and maximum dimensions are essential. Buyers should bring the mounting measurements or a detailed technical specification.

items.title: Repeatable Diamond Selections
items.body: Manufacturers may need diamonds that can be supplied within controlled measurement and quality ranges. Required tolerances, quantities, production stages and delivery expectations should be explained at the beginning of the discussion.

items.title: Matching and Calibration for Jewellery Production
items.body: Matched earrings, three-stone rings, eternity bands, tennis bracelets and other multi-stone pieces require visual consistency. Shape, measurements, colour, clarity and overall appearance may all need to be coordinated.

matching.title: Matching and Calibration for Jewellery Production
matching.para1: Matching is particularly important when several diamonds will be used together within the same jewellery design.
matching.para2: Diamond earrings, three-stone rings, eternity bands, tennis bracelets, tennis necklaces and other multi-stone pieces require consistency across relevant characteristics.
matching.para3: For jewellery manufacturers, accurate calibration can also support setting efficiency and production repeatability. Diamonds that vary significantly in size or proportion may require adjustments during setting and can create an uneven finished appearance.
matching.para4: Providing precise measurements and acceptable tolerances helps the proposed selection reflect the finished jewellery application.
matching.imageAlt: Matched pairs and calibrated natural diamonds for jewellery production

whyMeet.title: Why Meet Uniglo Diamonds at the Exhibition?
whyMeet.para1: Digital inventories and grading reports are useful during initial research, but an in-person viewing can reveal characteristics that standard data and photography do not communicate completely.
whyMeet.para2: Buyers can compare outline, face-up dimensions, proportions and overall visual appearance while discussing how each diamond will be positioned, set and sold.
whyMeet.para3: Uniglo Diamonds' Antwerp base also provides a connection to one of the world's established diamond-trading centres. The value of that background is supported by clear communication, properly understood specifications and consistent follow-up before and after the exhibition.

benefits: Examine available natural diamonds in person
Plan bridal and core diamond inventory

planning.title: Planning Your Visit to Messe München
planning.para1: INHORGENTA is intended exclusively for approved trade visitors. Visitors may be asked to provide trade accreditation, evidence of professional qualifications or relevant student documentation. A business card alone may not be accepted as proof of eligibility.
planning.para2: The ticket shop is scheduled to open on 5 December 2026. Ticket prices have not yet been published. Tickets should be purchased online where possible because the organiser advises that admission purchased at the venue may cost more and involve longer waiting times.
confirmItems: The latest exhibitor directory and hall plan
Uniglo Diamonds' confirmed hall and stand number
The diamond specifications you want to discuss
planning.transportPara1: Messe München is connected to central Munich by the U2 underground line. The Messestadt West and Messestadt Ost stations serve the exhibition grounds, with the most appropriate entrance depending on the final hall plan.
planning.transportPara2: The journey from Munich Central Station takes approximately 20 minutes without changing trains. An INHORGENTA admission ticket does not include travel on MVG, MVV or Deutsche Bahn services, so visitors must purchase the appropriate public-transport ticket separately.
planning.note: INHORGENTA tickets do not include local public transport, so visitors should plan their journey to Messe München separately.

partnerships.title: Partnerships That Continue Beyond Munich
partnerships.para1: The most valuable exhibition conversations are not always those that lead to an immediate order. Some begin with a specific diamond requirement, while others start with a wider discussion about a future collection, an inventory gap or a market opportunity.
partnerships.para2: After the exhibition, buyers may wish to request a more focused selection, review grading reports, refine measurement requirements or confirm quantities and production schedules.
partnerships.para3: Long-term diamond-sourcing relationships depend on more than the initial presentation. They are built through transparent communication, consistent quality, dependable service and an understanding of the buyer's commercial objectives.

items.question: When is INHORGENTA Munich 2027?
items.answer: The exhibition will take place from Friday, 19 February to Monday, 22 February 2027.

items.question: Where will the exhibition be held?
items.answer: It will be held at the Trade Fair Center Messe München, Am Messesee 2, 81829 Munich, Germany.

items.question: What are the visitor opening hours?
items.answer: Visitor hours are scheduled for 09:30–18:30 from 19 to 21 February and 09:30–17:00 on 22 February. Visitors should check the organiser's website for any changes before travelling.

items.question: Who can attend INHORGENTA?
items.answer: The exhibition is intended for approved professionals and eligible students connected with the jewellery, watch, gemstone, pearl, design and technology industries. Proof of eligibility may be required.

items.question: When does the ticket shop open?
items.answer: The 2027 ticket shop is scheduled to become available on 5 December 2026. Ticket prices will be published by the organiser.

items.question: Can visitors buy tickets at the venue?
items.answer: The organiser states that tickets can also be purchased at the exhibition. However, on-site admission may cost more and involve longer waiting times. Visitors registering at the venue must bring suitable trade accreditation.

items.question: Does admission include Munich public transport?
items.answer: No. An INHORGENTA ticket does not include travel on MVG, MVV or Deutsche Bahn services.

items.question: What is Uniglo Diamonds' stand number?
items.answer: Uniglo Diamonds' hall and stand number for the 2027 exhibition have not yet been officially confirmed. The information will be added to this page when available.

items.question: What can buyers discuss with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss natural diamonds for individual centre stones, bridal jewellery, matched pairs, calibrated layouts, existing mountings, manufacturing programmes and repeat-supply requirements.

items.question: Should buyers arrange a meeting in advance?
items.answer: Advance booking is recommended for buyers with specific diamond requirements. Providing shapes, carat ranges, measurements, quality preferences, quantities and documentation requirements will help the team prepare for the appointment.

finalCta.title: Book a Meeting with Uniglo Diamonds
finalCta.para: Meet Uniglo Diamonds in Munich to discuss natural diamonds selected around your retail, manufacturing, wholesale or bespoke-jewellery requirements. When requesting an appointment, include your preferred shapes, carat ranges, measurements, colours, clarities, quantities, grading-report requirements and intended jewellery applications.
finalCta.note: The confirmed hall and stand number will be published as soon as it becomes officially available. Ticket shop opens 5 December 2026.
